messages:
erin: CI red on main for TestSessionTimerSkew — flaked intermittently across several runs. Failing in the runner timer drift assertion. Anyone seen this before?

samir: link to the failing job?

erin: https://ci.company/runner/12345 — job: runner-integration. snippet below from the failing shard:
```
--- FAIL: TestSessionTimerSkew (0.02s)
    timer_test.go:87: expected session expired after 50ms, got 80ms
    runtime/runner.(*Session).tick+0x1a2
    testing.tRunner
```

erin: repro locally sometimes with `make test PKG=./runtime -run TestSessionTimerSkew -count 50` — about 1/10 runs fail for me.

ava: @erin can you rerun with `-run TestSessionTimerSkew -count 200 -test.v` so we get full timestamps?

ci-bot: Rerun requested by erin — queued: https://ci.company/runner/12345/rerun

jon: fyi: PR #2843 touched timer coalescing in the runner scheduler; could be related. cc @samir

samir: I glanced at #2843 — it adds jitter to reduce bursts. Might have accidentally shifted expiration checks. Will try a local revert.

ava: If it's nondet we should bisect. Do our tests support a deterministic seed for timers?

erin: yes — the test reads TEST_TIMER_SEED env var. I reproduced one failure with `TEST_TIMER_SEED=42`.

samir: great. I'll spin up a bisect across main~30..main and run the test with the seed to narrow it down. Need CI minutes though. If anyone has spare, ping.

ava: short-term mitigation: can we relax the assertion tolerance from 30ms to 60ms and add a TODO? We should avoid masking bugs long-term but buy time.

jon: agree on a temporary tolerance if we add a ticket and a deadline.

erin: created INF-912 and opened #2891 with a small tolerance bump + test TODO. Requesting review from @ava and @samir.

ci-bot: Rerun finished: 2/200 failed. Full logs: https://ci.company/runner/12345/456 

samir: seeing the same pattern locally after reverting #2843 — failure rate drops to ~0/200. Looks strongly correlated. I'll prepare a patch that adjusts jitter window and add a comment about test sensitivity.

ava: thanks. Please include an explicit note in the PR description that links INF-912 and the flaky runs.

erin: will do. If anyone else hits it, repro with `TEST_TIMER_SEED=42` and dump the `-test.v` logs into the issue.

samir: I'll update #2843 or revert depending on bisect. ping me if urgent. :thumbsup:

ava: marking INF-912 as in-progress and adding a 2-week deadline for removing the temporary tolerance. :spiral_calendar:

erin: thanks all — will follow up once bisect completes.
